email_body:
Hi Sofia,

I came across Sexting the Boss, your Secret Baby, Silver Fox office romance that arrived this spring, and the accidental text to a billionaire boss is such a fun, high-stakes way to start a workplace story. It stood out to me among the many releases in your Billionaire Baby Daddies series.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Sexting the Boss is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished files you can share on social media and your newsletter. It is a completely optional add-on, separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Sexting the Boss best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
